final_report: The patient exhibits severe, prolonged grade 4 thrombocytopenia lasting over 100 days, indicating profound bone marrow suppression and high bleeding risk. Despite good ECOG performance status and low comorbidity burden, the critical thrombocytopenia elevates mortality risk due to potential fatal hemorrhage. Concurrent grade 1 anemia may exacerbate hemodynamic instability, while smoking and obesity add cardiovascular risk.
